Before I can make an approval decision, I need to hear from both legal and treasury on any material findings and required closing controls. Could legal and treasury each walk me through what you've identified?

I confirmed that the KITE and NORTHSTAR agreements both prohibit assignment without consent. Excluding those invoices leaves exactly $7,200,000 eligible for sale — not the $8,500,000 in the preliminary proposal. Additionally, the closing file must include a signed assignment-consent package for both KITE and NORTHSTAR before we can proceed. I have not yet uploaded this review to the transaction folder, but I will do so promptly.
